mapper.sql: id, server_id, cpu_percent, memory_percent, memory_used, memory_total, disk_percent, disk_used, disk_total, net_rx, net_tx, temperature, load_avg, collected_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metrics (server_id, cpu_percent, memory_percent, memory_used, memory_total, disk_percent, disk_used, disk_total, net_rx, net_tx, temperature, load_avg, collected_at) VALUES (#{metric.serverId}, #{metric.cpuPercent}, #{metric.memoryPercent}, #{metric.memoryUsed}, #{metric.memoryTotal}, #{metric.diskPercent}, #{metric.diskUsed}, #{metric.diskTotal}, #{metric.netRx}, #{metric.netTx}, #{metric.temperature}, #{metric.loadAvg}, #{metric.collectedAt})
INSERT INTO metrics_ingestions (server_id, message_id, collected_at) VALUES (#{ingestion.serverId}, #{ingestion.messageId}, #{ingestion.collectedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM metrics WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
SELECT FROM metrics WHERE server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY collected_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
